answer.explanation: Live configuration (MemorySize, Timeout, environment variables, reserved concurrency, role) matches the SAM template for all four functions. A Logs Insights query over the window 22:40:58-22:50:58Z for error, exception, denied, timeout and fail patterns across all four log groups returned zero records. In-window invocations completed normally, with REPORT lines showing durations well under timeout and memory use within the configured size. The Uploader was modified at 22:30:42Z, before the window, and its live settings still match the template. Its NoSuchBucket PutObject errors at 22:25Z fall outside the window and were not used.
